visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens at night on a balcony; a woman with long brown hair wearing a beige bunny-patterned shirt and a man in a khaki shirt look at the illuminated Tokyo Skytree. The woman turns toward the camera with a bright, wide-eyed smile and an open mouth. (2) The scene cuts to a well-lit train interior where the woman and a man wearing a white cap sit together, both giving thumbs-up gestures while the woman holds a gold smartphone. (3) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the red lantern of Senso-ji Temple, a giant 3D cat animation on a building screen, and the woman walking through a densely crowded street during the day. (4) Indoors in a living room, three people sit on a couch showing their iPhone screens displaying high step counts (16,000+); they then toast with cans at a wooden dining table in front of a TV. (5) A close-up unboxing shows black boxes of 'Grandma's Formula' foot patches; the woman demonstrates applying a dark patch to the sole of her foot while sitting on a bed. (6) The final sequence shows multiple used patches laid out on a floor, the woman applying makeup with a brush, and a group of three running away from the camera down a narrow urban alley under bright daylight.
